Publish a paid plugin

Submit a signed BYgram plugin and connect your TON wallet.

Package and sign

Choose a unique manifest ID and a version. Keep the same ID and signing key for updates. Store the RSA private key outside the source directory. Install OpenSSL and get the packager from the package guide.

Submit and connect a wallet

In the current BYgram beta, open BYgram Settings → Plugins → Official Catalog → Submit a plugin. Set the price and select the signed archive. To accept TON, connect an active V3R2, V4R2 or V5R1 wallet using the author wallet page and the same Telegram account. Moderators review the exact SHA-256.

Payments and updates

TON goes directly to the author. A wallet change applies to new orders. Confirmed purchases are tied to the buyer’s Telegram account. The author handles mandatory TON refunds, and BYgram support can forward a request.
